summary: Umpqua National Forest lookout first built in 1934; the R-6 tower standing now was moved here in 1976, and the site is staffed in summer.

facts.design: R-6 flattop cab with catwalk on a treated timber tower

access.note: Road to the top; staffed in summer. A 2023 visitor was allowed up with staff permission, so ask staff before going up.

visit.trail_note: From the Highway 230 and 138 junction, drive north 7.9 miles on 138, turn onto gravel Road 4793, then drive about 1.5 miles of dirt road to the lookout (2023 visit).

corrections.why: 10.7 m is 35 feet, the height Forest Lookouts gives for the 1934 tower. The tower standing now is 41 feet per firelookout.com (44 feet per the register).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The first lookout on the site was an L-4 cab completed in 1934. The 1955 date in the record is for the R-6 tower first erected on Buster Butte, which was moved here in 1976.

sources.title: Cinnamon Butte, Every Lookout in Oregon

notes_for_editor: Heights conflict: the 1934 tower is 35 ft (Forest Lookouts) vs 30 ft (firelookout.com and the register); the present tower is 41 ft (firelookout.com) vs 44 ft (register). Staffing as_of 2023 comes from the Cheryl Hill visit; firelookout.com's staffing note is undated. Access level permission is a judgment from the 2023 post and was not checked against Forest Service rules. Elevation: record 1953.8 m matches the register's 6,410 ft; firelookout.com gives 6,417 ft.
